spoliarium

In the dark cellar of a Roman arena, slaves drag the bodies of fallen gladiators away, as crowds look on. Juan Luna from the Philippines won the top prize at an art show in Madrid in 1884 with this huge painting, among the biggest in the world. Filipinos were proud that one of their own beat the best European artists. It's a national treasure of the Philippines.
little-girl-in-a-blue-armchair

A girl slouches in a big blue armchair in a living room, looking bored, with a sleeping dog in another chair. Cassatt painted a child's real attitude instead of making her look perfect. Degas helped with the painting, they say. It's one of the most famous paintings of childhood.
san-giorgio-maggiore-at-dusk

A church on a small island in Venice glows pink and gold, and the water shimmers in purple and blue. Monet painted it in 1908 on a trip with his wife, and he finished some of the pictures at home. The colors melt like a dream. It's a lovely view of an unforgettable city.
the-tower-of-blue-horses

Four bright blue horses stand huddled together in a landscape of red, yellow and purple. Franz Marc believed animals were pure and innocent, and he used colors to show feelings, not to match real life. The painting disappeared during World War II and has never been found. It is one of the most famous lost paintings.
farms-near-auvers

Thatched farmhouses sit beside a golden wheat field and a path, under a bright blue sky with a swirl of clouds. Van Gogh painted it near Paris in the last weeks of his life. The roofs are in warm greens and reds. It's a happy look at rural life.
marriage-of-sisley

A couple stands arm in arm and smiles, the man holding his wife's arm. Renoir painted his friend, the Impressionist Alfred Sisley, and his future wife, Eugénie. It's a tender portrait of friendship and love. It's a fond record of an artist and his companion.
the-reading

A woman in a white dress sits by a window, reading, as a man looks away from a book at her. Manet's wife, Suzanne, posed for it. The painting is calm and gentle. It's a pleasant moment of a quiet day.
the-oxbow

A curving river winds through a green valley as a storm clears. A tiny painter at an easel stands on the hillside in the corner. Thomas Cole showed that nature was big and beautiful, and humans were small. It's one of the most famous American landscape paintings.
girl-in-a-wood

A girl in a dark dress stands among tall beech trees with brown leaves. Van Gogh painted it in the Netherlands when he was starting out. The mix of light and shadow is lively. It's a rustic look at an early painting.
jeune-fille-au-piano-girl-at-the-piano-the-overture-to-tannh

A young woman sits at a piano, playing, as an older woman sews in a rocking chair. Cézanne painted his sister and mother in a bold, flat way. The famous music of Wagner's Tannhäuser was the inspiration. It's a quiet moment in a family.
countess-of-chinchon

A young noblewoman in a pale dress with a feathery hairdo sits with her hands folded, wearing a soft, thoughtful look. Goya painted her when she was about 20, a few years after she'd been forced into a marriage. He saw the sadness in her eyes, and the portrait is full of feeling. It's one of his greatest portraits.
boy-carrying-a-sword

A boy in a white shirt and a big hat carries a sword that's too big for him, with a bright sash and pale background. Manet painted it as a young artist, inspired by the Spanish masters. It's both charming and bold. It's an early favorite.
ulysses-and-the-sirens

The hero Ulysses is lashed to the mast of his ship as bird-women, the sirens, swoop and sing to lure him. His crew, ears plugged, row on. Waterhouse painted the sirens with a wild energy. It's a famous scene from the Odyssey.
a-philosopher-by-lamplight

An old philosopher in a red hat sits reading by the light of a single lamp, which makes his face glow in the dark. Wright of Derby was a master of dramatic candlelight. The picture makes you think about the quiet joy of studying. It's a model of strong light and shadow.
the-immaculate-conception

Mary floats in a pale blue gown, standing on a crescent moon and surrounded by angels, in a cloud of golden light. Tiepolo painted it for a church in Madrid. The airy colors make the whole scene look like it's floating. It's one of the most graceful paintings of the Baroque era.
lady-in-blue

A woman in a blue dress, her hands in her lap, sits with a steady look. Cézanne painted her in a patchwork of blue and tan strokes. His later portraits are made of blocks of color. It's an example of his simple but powerful way of painting.
the-nut-gatherers

Two girls in a forest rest after gathering nuts, one of them sitting with a basket and the other reclining. Bouguereau was a master of smooth, careful finish. The fresh-faced girls seem to glow in the green woods. It's a sweet, natural scene.
king-cophetua-and-the-beggar-maid

A king sits on the steps of his throne, wearing golden armor, gazing up at a barefoot beggar girl who holds a flower. According to a legend, he fell in love with her and made her his queen. Burne-Jones painted a glittering, richly decorated scene. It's a fairy tale in paint.
le-pont-de-l-europe

A tall iron bridge crosses a train station, with a man in a top hat looking over the rail. Caillebotte painted the new Paris of steel and steam. The perspective lines pull you into the picture. It's one of the first paintings about industry and the city.
general-johnson-saving-a-wounded-french-officer-from-the-tom

In a scene from the French and Indian War, a British officer protects a wounded French soldier. Benjamin West, an American in London, painted it with dramatic action in the forest. It shows kindness in a time of war. It's an early work of American-born art.
jason-and-medea

The hero Jason watches as the sorceress Medea mixes a magic potion to help him win the Golden Fleece. Waterhouse painted her in a rich turquoise gown, with a cauldron and flames. The picture is filled with mystery. It's a favorite of fans of Greek legends.
the-hireling-shepherd

A shepherd flirts with a girl in a sunlit field as the sheep stray into the wheat. Hunt painted each leaf, each tuft of wool, in vivid color. He meant it as a lesson about neglecting duty. It's a joyous, detailed picture.
rideau-cruchon-et-compotier

A pitcher, a fruit bowl and a patterned curtain are arranged on a table, with apples and peaches that seem to tilt. Cézanne changed the viewpoint on purpose, as if he moved while painting. It's like a puzzle made of color. It helped lead the way to Cubism.
bubbles

A boy gazes at a soap bubble he has just blown, with a dreamy look. Millais painted it as a picture of his grandson, 'A Child's World.' It was later used in a soap advertisement, which made it one of the most famous paintings ever. It's a well-known image of childhood wonder.
pink-roses

Pink roses burst from a vase against a pale green background. Van Gogh painted it in Auvers-sur-Oise in his final months. The roses were originally a bright pink, though the color has faded. It's a lovely flower painting.
the-abduction-of-psyche

Winged spirits carry the maiden Psyche up into the sky in a swirl of silks. In the story, she's taken to a palace where she meets Cupid. Bouguereau painted a beautiful, soft scene. It's an enchanting picture of ancient myth.
the-siesta-after-millet

A farming couple takes a nap in the shade of a haystack, with their tools beside them. Van Gogh copied the design of a Millet print and put it into his own bold colors. He said it was like translating into another language. It shows his love for the painter Millet.
the-parasol

A young woman sits on a grassy bank with a little dog on her lap, as a young man holds a bright green parasol over her. Goya designed this as a pattern for a tapestry for a royal palace. The colors are cheerful and bright. It's a delightful picture of leisure.
a-girl-with-a-watering-can

A little girl in a blue dress holds a watering can on a path with flowers and dappled light. Renoir captured a child's quiet game in a garden. It's very peaceful and sweet. The painting is in the National Gallery of Art in Washington.
sunset

A calm sunset glows red and gold behind a quiet landscape, with black trees on the horizon. Friedrich painted this late in life. The quiet colors remind us of the end of a day. It's a gentle painting.
black-circle

A single big black circle sits on a white square. Malevich painted it as a partner to his Black Square, and it might be a symbol of a wheel or of a whole world. It was among the boldest artworks of the 1920s. It's a minimal abstraction.
the-swan-princess

A bird-woman with a swan's wings looks back over her shoulder against a darkening sky, wearing a jeweled crown. Vrubel painted the Swan Princess from a Russian opera, and his wife sang the role. The shimmering colors look like mosaic. It's one of the most captivating Russian fairy-tale paintings.
cart-with-black-ox

A big black ox pulls a farm cart across a field, under a stormy sky. Van Gogh painted the dark, heavy earth colors in the Netherlands when he lived with his parents. The ox seems strong and patient. It's an early look at rural labor.
boreas

A young woman in a flowing robe struggles against the cold north wind, represented by Boreas. In Greek myth, Boreas was the god of the north wind. Waterhouse painted him coming from the cloud with a mighty gust. It's a magical picture of weather.
frenzy-of-exultations

A wild-eyed man rides a rearing black horse that tramples a woman, in a vivid painting of passion. Podkowiński made this in 1894 and showed it in Warsaw, where it caused a huge uproar. He eventually slashed it with a knife. It's a famous Polish Symbolist painting.
madonnina

A shy girl wearing a blue-and-white headscarf looks out with a sweet, solemn face. The girl, Angelina, was a street kid in Venice who sold flowers. The painting won a top prize at an exhibition in 1897. It became one of the most-copied pictures in Italy.
witches-flight

A group of figures, with pointed hats, fly through the sky as they hold up a man, in a swirl of eerie blue and gray. Goya painted a world of superstition and fear. It's meant to make people think about the foolish things people believe. It's a spooky picture.
boating

A man in a straw hat and a woman in a blue dress sit in a sailboat on a sparkling river, painted in a very bold crop. Manet painted it in the summer of 1874 at Argenteuil with Monet nearby. The blue water fills most of the canvas. It's a refreshing scene.
woman-with-a-pearl-necklace-in-a-loge

A woman in a pale dress with a pearl necklace sits in a theater box, leaning forward and holding a fan. Cassatt painted this for the 1879 Impressionist show, with the glow of the theater lamps. She looks across at the audience while being observed herself. It's a picture of a woman who is clever and independent.
comtesse-d-haussonville

A French countess leans on her hand with a thoughtful look, in a satin blue dress. Ingres painted her over three years, and the textures of the flowers and silk are exquisite. A mirror shows the back of her head. It's a famous painting in the Frick Collection in New York.
still-life-with-straw-hat

A straw hat lies on a wall in dark shadows, painted with little dashes. Van Gogh worked on it in the Netherlands. The hat is a cheerful sign of summer. It's a small, humble object painted with affection.
sleep-and-his-half-brother-death

Two winged brothers from Greek myth, Sleep and Death, lie side by side on a bed of poppies, in a quiet, dreamy pose. Waterhouse painted them in a haze of purple and gold. Sleep is the one who clutches a poppy. It's a peaceful picture of a serious subject.
after-dinner-at-ornans

A group of men sit relaxed around a table in a warm room after dinner, one of them playing a violin. Courbet painted his friends and his father in a dark, calm space. The painting won him a medal and was bought by the state. It's the start of his fame.
ceremonial-sitting-of-the-state-council-on-7-may-1901-markin

Dozens of officials in uniform sit and stand in a vast hall, in a massive group portrait for the 100th anniversary of Russia's State Council. Repin painted 81 individual portraits with the help of his students. It's a record-setting giant canvas, over 4 meters tall. It's a window into a world that was about to vanish.
the-bacchante

A woman in a theatrical pose leans on a stone, holding a cup, in a wild forest. In ancient times, a bacchante was a follower of the wine god. Courbet painted it early in his career, in a Romantic manner. It's an experiment before he turned to Realism.
